verdict.rationale: Self-hosting or on-prem deployment is a fair question when comparing cloud platforms, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Google Cloud's core platform can be self-hosted. Workload Identity Federation only lets on-prem workloads reach Google-hosted resources, and the open-source MCP Toolbox is a peripheral tool, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
